game.title: Ghost of Tsushima
game.blurb: Open-world samurai action-adventure set on the island of Tsushima in 1274, from Sucker Punch Productions, released 2020-07-17. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The last samurai's fight back against the Mongol invasion, act by act. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Liberating Tsushima
chapters.summary: Freeing the occupied areas of Izuhara, Toyotama and Kamiagata, and growing your Legend.

chapters.title: Tales and Duels
chapters.summary: Mythic Tales, the Tales of Tsushima and every duel.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Lighthouses, Shinto and Inari shrines, hot springs, haiku, bamboo strikes, records, Mongol artifacts, gifts and vanity gear.

chapters.title: Combat, Stances and Gear
chapters.summary: Parries, staggers, standoffs, the four stances, Ghost Stance, Ghost weapons, sword upgrades and charms.

chapters.title: Iki Island (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Iki Island story, its tales, liberation, unwritten tales and the Hidden Cove bokken tournament.

chapters.title: Legends (online co-op)
chapters.summary: Legends Mode stories, Raids, Survival, Rivals, class ranks and Legends gear.

chapters.title: New Game+
chapters.summary: A second run of the story and the New Game+ shop.

Fandom (ghostoftsushima.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://ghostoftsushima.fandom.com/wiki/Ghost_of_Tsushima
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but not written, and only Achievements and trophies, Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. ghostoftsushima.fandom.com answers the API, with about 153 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is the Director's Cut (2215430); the Steam schema calls it "Reign" (an internal codename). 31 of 77 Steam achievements are hidden. The 7 hidden ones listed in the Iki Island block (from "Out of the Past" to "Blood on Your Hands") were put in the Iki Island chapter by schema position. The rest sit in the main story chapter; about 10 of them (for example "The Warrior Monk", "Den of Thieves", "Cooper Clan Cosplayer", unlock rates 5 to 49 percent) are probably side content and need checking. "Honor Bound" (bind gear to a class) was put in Legends by its schema position next to the Rivals achievements.
